summary: Completed backend + frontend integration testing against public preview URL. Backend API suite passed; key gameplay, wallet-no-extension path, simulated injected-wallet handling, mobile overflow, and core UI controls were verified.

ui_bugs.issue: Intermittent failure while deploying second crew member (net) from dialog: placement bar remains visible and worker HUD entry does not appear within timeout.

integration_issues.issue: Chain switch rejection path correctly shows error text ('User rejected the request.'); no blocker, but keep explicit UX handling copy reviewed.

action_items: Investigate intermittent crew deploy race/failure for second worker from UI dialog (net case observed repeatedly).
Consider adding deterministic UI feedback element (data-testid) for action errors/toast content so automation can assert conflict/error causes.
Keep wallet wrong-chain rejection messaging as-is or refine copy if product wants friendlier message.
critical_code_review_comments: Game action API is server-authoritative and concurrency-safe (revision-based replace) but client does not retry transient action conflicts; this likely contributes to observed intermittent deploy failure.
Environment variable usage is correct in core files (frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; backend uses MONGO_URL/DB_NAME).
No BSON serialization leaks detected in API responses under concurrent reads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite already exists at /app/backend/tests/test_game_api.py and passed fully. Frontend core flow passes, but intermittent second-crew deployment issue reproduced in 2 runs. Mobile 390x844 showed no horizontal overflow even with 3 workers prepared via TEST FIXTURE API calls tied to same session.
rca of the issue: Repro steps: PLAY -> free demo -> deploy rod -> open crew -> select net -> choose -> place fisherman. In repeated runs, placement bar stayed and worker-net did not appear. Likely root cause: transient action failure/race (client action has no retry and relies on toast only). Mitigation: add idempotent/retry logic for deploy on recoverable 409/busy and expose deterministic error state in DOM for testability.
